data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and fund pilot
data.body:
Your most recent 13F, for the period June 30, 2026, shows positions in AVBH, FCBM, and FRST.

On September 18, 2026, FCBM disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1531193/000110465926108950/tm2625756d1_8k.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
